svg.title: Aubade
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Observed white square with narrow yellow upper-left wedge, separate upper-right curved wedge and yellow lower-left field. White ground retained.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://collection.carnegieart.org/objects/34bc4285-1106-46cd-b6b7-8346c4cde531; source object 58.70; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
